title: Replicating refusal steering on a reasoning model and probing the chain-of-thought

original_idea.body: Apply a refusal steering vector to a small open reasoning model and analyze whether steering shifts the reasoning trace, the final answer, or both, measuring CoT-vs-answer dissociation.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: CoT-vs-answer dissociation under refusal steering probes the unfaithful-CoT model-organism threat.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Refusal steering on small reasoning model + analysis; one GPU.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model-organism-flavored probing on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Refusal steering established; CoT-dissociation on reasoning models may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The CoT-dissociation twist may be partly open.
